create_SE2_from_xy_theta: create an SE2 object from a batch of x, y, theta values using x_y_theta tensor
generate_random_SE2: generate random SE2 transformations using SE2.rand with a specified batch size
compose_SE2_transformations: compose two SE2 transformations together using the compose method to chain poses
transform_point_with_SE2: transform a 2D point using SE2.transform_from to apply rotation and translation
compute_SE2_exp_map: compute the exponential map of a tangent vector to get an SE2 transformation
